contraveners_final_after_decision.name: contraveners_final_after_decision
contraveners_final_after_decision.value: final_date is null or final_date >= decision_date

contraveners_executed_after_decision.name: contraveners_executed_after_decision
contraveners_executed_after_decision.value: executed_on is null or executed_on >= decision_date

defendants_status_date.name: defendants_status_date
defendants_status_date.value: (status = 'inculpat' and convicted_on is null) or (status = 'condamnat' and convicted_on is not null)

hearings_counts_check.name: hearings_counts_check
hearings_counts_check.value: tc_petrecute >= 0 and tc_amanate >= 0 and ij_petrecute >= 0 and ij_amanate >= 0

obligations_day_check.name: obligations_day_check
obligations_day_check.value: day_of_month is null or day_of_month between 1 and 31

obligations_weekday_check.name: obligations_weekday_check
obligations_weekday_check.value: weekday is null or weekday between 0 and 6

obligations_kind_fields.name: obligations_kind_fields
obligations_kind_fields.value:
(kind = 'lunar_zi' and day_of_month is not null and weekday is null)
        or (kind = 'lunar_ultima_zi' and day_of_month is null and weekday is null)
        or (kind = 'saptamanal' and weekday is not null and day_of_month is null)

transfer_plans_institution_check.name: transfer_plans_institution_check
transfer_plans_institution_check.value: institution between 1 and 18 and institution not in (6, 14)

transfer_plans_temei.name: transfer_plans_temei
transfer_plans_temei.value:
(basis = 'sedinta' and hearing_date is not null and decision_date is null and ruling_date is null and court is not null)
        or (basis = 'decizie' and decision_date is not null and hearing_date is null and ruling_date is null)
        or (basis = 'termen30' and ruling_date is not null and term_start is not null and hearing_date is null and decision_date is null and court is not null)

transfer_plans_instiintare.name: transfer_plans_instiintare
transfer_plans_instiintare.value: (notified_at is null and notified_hearing_date is null) or (notified_at is not null and notified_hearing_date is not null)

transfer_plans_ruling_before_start.name: transfer_plans_ruling_before_start
transfer_plans_ruling_before_start.value: ruling_date is null or term_start is null or ruling_date <= term_start

transfers_institution_check.name: transfers_institution_check
transfers_institution_check.value: institution between 1 and 18 and institution not in (6, 14)
